about: Held-out set (plan, 2026-10-17): questions over documents the pipeline was never tuned on. Five Gutenberg books ingested into their own database (ACCEPTANCE_DB=veriforge_accept_heldout, GUTENBERG_SET=heldout): Dracula, The Picture of Dorian Gray, Jane Eyre, A Tale of Two Cities, Candide. Same scorer and fields as evals/acceptance/books.json. Frozen: no threshold, prompt or label is changed because of how this set scores; a miss is reported per category and a failure reopens ADR-006. Bar: 0 confident wrong and at most 5% false abstention overall, reported per category. Should-decline items include questions about books deliberately absent from this corpus (Wuthering Heights, Pride and Prejudice, Les Miserables) and a Great Expectations character asked about in A Tale of Two Cities.
